text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft couldn't take 1st place in the 
Oka Sho. Yet, spurred on by the cheers of 
the crowd, she rallies herself, knowing 
her challenge isn't over yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, at a press conference, Cesario and 
Air Messiah declared their intention to 
enter the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft declares the NHK Mile Cup as 
her next race. The reporters erupt with 
excitement over a challenge no one has 
ever achieved before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Daring Heart also announced that her 
next race would be the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft was surprised by her 
declaration. The two of them would now 
clash at the NHK Mile Cup...
